_categories.basis: chooses which implementation runs; proved equivalent, so not comparable
_categories.debug: prints; changes nothing the board sees
_categories.experiment: a routing lever tier 2 may move
_categories.internal: an internal mode, not a lever
_categories.io: reads or writes a file; changes the input or the output, not the board
_categories.reserved: the owner's, refused with its reason and routed to the decisions file

_stages.pair: runs pair_preroute on an already placed board
_stages.place: regenerates the placement, then the pair passes

_what: The typed knob registry (MESHSAT-862, 12 September 2026). CATEGORY IS THE AUTHORITY: only an `experiment` knob may be proposed by tier 2. Reading a name from the source told us the name exists, never that it is a lever, and the red team was right that this reversed the authority: PAIR_PLAN_OUT, PAIR_DEBUG and PAIR_NO_NUMBA were all proposable. The source scan is a COMPLETENESS check now: every name the tools read must appear here, and a test says so.

PAIR_BUDGET.description: the outer wall-clock safety net per pair; the work budget is the real one

PAIR_CORRIDOR_SLACK.description: how much wider than the pair the corridor must be; the one lever with a curve

PAIR_CORRIDOR_SLACK_SLIM.description: the per-pair retry slack when no corridor is found

PAIR_COVER_LEGS.description: the corridor covers its own legs plus a grid cell

PAIR_CROSS_NET.description: what a cross-net raster hit does; report by default, a raster must not decide alone

PAIR_DEBUG.description: prints why a cell was refused; changes nothing the board sees

PAIR_END_LEGS.description: the end emissions lay offset legs

PAIR_END_OFFSET.description: the legs are offset by half the pair pitch

PAIR_END_STRICT.description: judge the end emissions at the gate's bar as they are laid

PAIR_ENTRY_STRICT.description: the entry region is asked rather than skipped

PAIR_ENTRY_VIA.description: the escape-via entry as a per-pair fallback

PAIR_EXPANSIONS.description: work budget per pair across all its searches; 0 is off

PAIR_FAN_BACK.description: how far the P leg is pulled back before the N fan of a dive is laid

PAIR_FAST_SEARCH.description: the compiled corridor search, proved identical by pairsearch selftest

PAIR_FAST_STUBS.description: the compiled stub search, proved identical on B19

PAIR_FOLD_TEST.description: the fold test at half the pair pitch

PAIR_GRID_LONG.description: a coarser grid for the long pairs; 0 is off

PAIR_HOP_LAYERS.description: same as PAIR_LAYERS: it decides which layers a pair may change on

PAIR_INNER.description: pair class geometry: the inner-layer width and gap are an impedance target

PAIR_INNER_GAP.description: the intra-pair gap is an impedance target and at 0.09 mm it breaks KiCad's own clearance rule

PAIR_INNER_WIDTH.description: track width against the stackup is an impedance target

PAIR_LAYERS.description: a pair moved to an inner layer becomes a stripline and needs its own geometry, which is reserved

PAIR_LEG_EXACT.description: re-test a blocked leg point against the polygons

PAIR_LEG_RETRY.description: block the refusing corridor cell and search again

PAIR_LONG_MM.description: the span above which a pair counts as long

PAIR_MAP_CHECK.description: an equivalence check, not a lever: slower, and changes nothing

PAIR_MAP_MODE.description: counts or reference occupancy maps, proved identical on all 75 of D's calls

PAIR_MITRE_LIMIT.description: the corner mitre limit in the leg offset

PAIR_NO_NUMBA.description: prevents the compiled kernel loading at all: the same basis question from the other side

PAIR_ORDER.description: the order pairs are attempted in; the pass is greedy so order decides

PAIR_ORDER_FILE.description: reads the pair order from a file: changes the input, not the board

PAIR_OWN_CLEAR.description: the emissions ask the partner before laying

PAIR_PLAN_IN.description: lays a negotiated plan instead of searching

PAIR_PLAN_MODE.description: selects the negotiated planner, measured and rejected for B19 (32.102)

PAIR_PRESENT.description: the presentation offset at an entry station

PAIR_RIPUP.description: rip-up as a trial kept only when it leaves more pairs laid

PAIR_RIP_MARGIN.description: the corridor margin a rip-up episode works in

PAIR_RIP_MAX.description: pairs one rip-up episode may lift

PAIR_RIP_TOTAL.description: pairs all rip-up episodes may lift in a pass

PAIR_STATION_OWN.description: the legs may pass the pair's own copper at a station

PAIR_STRIP_MM.description: how much escape chain is stripped at a fine-pitch station

PAIR_STUB_EXPANSIONS.description: work budget for one stub search

PAIR_SWAP.description: swap a station's two parts to untwist the pair

PAIR_SWAP_BOTH_SIDES.description: refuse a swap that crosses the parts' other pads

PAIR_UNMERGE.description: judge the unmerged polyline as well as the merged one

PAIR_VENV.description: chooses the numba venv or the plain kernel; 13x the wall time, 0 of 7,706 items different

PAIR_VIA_CANDS.description: via sites tried at a station before the section fails

PAIR_VIA_MODE.description: the via the pair uses: its class via or the board minimum

PAIR_WINDOW.description: the search box around a pair

PLACE_COUPLE_GAP.description: the gap between a differential pair's two coupling capacitors; +8 pairs on B at 2.4 (32.147)

PLACE_FINE_MARGIN.description: the margin the packer leaves around a fine-pitch part
